_from: docs/weka-art/config.json (every <id> was weka), cut down to one cut-out, one scene and the home card. Check with: python3 scripts/game_art.py <id> paint OUT --dry-run

styles.b: Handmade plasticine claymation scene, everything sculpted from smooth modelling clay with soft fingerprint texture, chunky rounded shapes, bright cheerful colours, soft studio light.

pictures.name: ten-frame
pictures.prompt: Top-down flat-on view of a chunky wide rectangular ten-frame tray made of one single honey-coloured clay, a smooth board with a raised rounded rim, and ten round shallow dents pressed into the board, all the same size, all the same honey colour as the board, in a perfect grid of two straight rows of five, evenly spaced, tidy and symmetrical, wide landscape. Single object, centred, the whole tray visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around. Suitable for young children aged 5 to 7.

pictures.name: back-morning
pictures.prompt: A wide view of a sunny New Zealand bush stream seen from the side: a grassy near bank along the bottom, a calm, wide, shallow stream right across the middle with smooth plain water, a far bank with ferns, flax and native bush behind it, a tidy uncluttered scene with an empty middle band of water, bright blue sky, the water clear light blue and calm. Empty background scenery for a children's game, calm soft colours in the middle so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape. Suitable for young children aged 5 to 7.

pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: Weka, a cute round New Zealand <id> bird, streaky warm brown and chestnut feathers, a strong straight grey beak, bright friendly red eyes, rosy cheeks, sturdy pinkish-red legs and feet, a short perky tail, wearing a little knitted green scarf, facing to the right, side view, hopping happily along a straight line of round grey stepping stones across a sunny bush stream, a big flat sandy-gold rock in the middle of the line, a picnic basket waiting on the far bank, wide landscape picture for a game title card. Suitable for young children aged 5 to 7.
